segments.text: Good morning, can I help you?
Yes, I'm looking for a book on business management,
but I don't know how the UE library system works,
as I've just arrived in the UK, and I missed the library induction session.
OK, that's fine. Do you know the name of the book you need to borrow?
Yes, I think it's called Strategic Management,
Creating Competitive Advantages.
OK, let me look it up for you on the website.
Here it is, Strategic Management, Creating Competitive Advantages, by Gregory White.
That sounds perfect. How can I find it?
Right, I'll just show you how to look it up on the library catalogue.
So, first you go into the library website, click on Using the Library, and then Borrow Things.
Now you can use the library catalogue to find books, e-books, journals and e-journals.
Oh, I see. That looks straightforward. It's good to know all that is available.
So where exactly do I find the book on strategic management?
OK, let's have a look at the catalogue information for your book.
Can you see the number 6397012WHI?
Yes. What does it all mean?
Well, 639 is the shelf number, 7012 is the book number and WHI is the call number. This
relates to the author's surname.
So the surname is white, not Gregory?
Yes, surnames are used for referencing and cataloging, so you need to be clear about which
is the author's surname and which is their first name.
I always get confused about that, and are the business books on level 2?
No, the location for business books is level 5.
You can also see here that there are 5 books available.
Great, so how long can I borrow the book for?
Well, the take-out time is 4 weeks, or 7 days, or overnight.
There are fines for overdue books.
For a 7 day loan it's 55 pence per day, 30 pence per day for a 4 week loan and 40 pence
per hour or part hour for an overnight loan.
The maximum fines for the first two loans is £10 and £20 for the last one.
Oh, I have to be careful not to return the books late then.
Yes, remember you can only pay fines once your overdue items are returned or renewed.
You can use the self-service machines in the library to do this, but they only take coins
and do not give change.
Or you can log into your library account and pay online.
There's a minimum of £5 to do this.
That could be expensive if I forget too often.
Oh, I just remembered a couple more things.
Where is the scanner and can I borrow a laptop?
The scanner is on the fourth floor by the student IT services desk.
You can use this for free.
forget if you have any IT problems the student IT services staff are always
there to help you. The laptops can also be booked online and you'll see the
lockers holding them by the IT desk also. How long can I use a laptop for? You can
take one out until midnight. If you return it late the fine is 50p per hour.
If you damage lose or do not return it the replacement cost fine is 70 pounds.
PC's can be accessed with a UE username and password.
Thank you, that's good to know. Are there different floors in the library used for different things?
Yes, Level 2 is Quiet Study, Level 3 is Group Study,
Level 4 is Silent Study and Level 3 is also available for bookable rooms.
Great, thank you for all your help. I have to go to my lecture now.
That's fine, we're always here to help.
